maria: Heads up — prototyping a 'per-route effective unit cost' card for the cost dashboard. Idea is a single card that surfaces model_sku, quantization profile, cache-adjusted per-token cost, and routing policy impact (canary vs stable). Quick thoughts?

jia: Love the idea. Two immediate asks: 1) define stable math for cache savings attribution, 2) make sure rollouts/canaries don't cause misleading spikes. Example: route A -> primary M1, fallback M2; cached prefix from M1 isn't reusable on M2, so we need to decide who gets the credit.

tom: For attribution I suggest we do base attribution on actual token consumption (what was billed) and then add a separate 'cache_delta' column that shows estimated savings if the original route had hit cache. Simple formula: `effective_cost = raw_token_cost - (cache_hits * avg_saved_tokens * token_price)`. Keep cache delta as an estimate, not part of billed cost.

vikram: Edge case: canary churn. During rollouts we get parallel routing and extra cold-cache hits which inflate raw_cost. We should compute a 'rollout_adjustment' normalization: est steady-state weights vs observed weights, and present adjusted effective_cost. Also add confidence interval when sample size < N.

emily: UX: show both distribution (per-request histogram with filters) and aggregated metrics (median, p95, p99). Users ask for "typical" vs "worst-case". Also allow toggle: show costs with/without cache-credit and with/without rollout adj. :sparkles:

chris: Telemetry question — do we currently persist enough per-request metadata? We need at minimum: `route_id`, `model_sku`, `quant_profile`, `cache_hit` (bool), `cache_saved_tokens` (int), `fallback_to` (nullable model/skuid), `routing_weight_at_time`. Right now logs only have `model_sku` and `cache_hit` which isn't enough to backfill attribution. If we add fields we can recompute historical views going forward.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: routing-metrics v2 rolled out to prod us-west-2 — 2026-03-20 14:12:03 UTC (canary 10% -> 100%)

maria: Nice, thanks. Action items: (1) chris to propose telemetry schema change + retention impact, (2) tom/jia to draft SQL/ES queries for raw_cost + cache_delta + rollout_adj, (3) emily to mock card with hist + aggregates, (4) vikram to add canary sim tests for dashboard QA. I'll make a GH issue and tag folks.

jia: :thumbsup:

tom: I'll draft the query today and attach sample numbers from prod.

emily: I'll do two variants (compact card + expanded panel) and post screenshots.

vikram: Also adding a small e2e test that simulates a 10% canary with fallback spikes so we can validate the rollout_adjustment math.

maria: Great — let's sync in async comments on the GH issue. If anyone hits blocking infra retention concerns call me.
